We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is implicit? We need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups? Could be a known molecule? No context. We need to retrieve something? Maybe we need to get carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons (CH3). Could also use proton NMR to see methyl signals.

We need to first get the proton NMR spectra. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no input needed). It will return spectra string. Then we can count methyl peaks (singlets around 0.9 ppm etc). But we need to interpret. Might be easier to get carbon NMR and count signals around 10-30 ppm typical for methyl carbons.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
